+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""
+Liveness guard for the po-2023 embeddings + STT chain.
+
+WHY THIS EXISTS
+---------------
+Three RAG outages in three days (2026-10-27, 2026-10-29 09:21Z, 2026-10-29 16:30Z)
+plus a fourth on 2026-10-29 evening. Each one took the whole fleet's retrieval
+down (7 Open-WebUI tenants, EPF students included) and none of them was caught
+by an existing instrument:
+
+  * the container healthcheck only looks at the container;
+  * the fleet guard (#220) covers "engine DOWN", not "relay dead while engine up";
+  * a TCP port that accepts proves nothing. On 2026-10-27 `:8004` accepted the
+    connection and returned no HTTP at all.
+
+The 2026-10-29 episode is the textbook case: the chain went 502 (facade alive,
+backend dead) -> 500 (container back, internal error) -> 401 (someone sending a
+fingerprint instead of a key). A port probe sees nothing through all three.
+
+WHAT IS CHECKED
+---------------
+1. Docker engine reachable (discriminates "engine dead" from "service dead").
+2. Embeddings through the FLEET path :8004 -> a REAL POST /v1/embeddings with
+   the key; requires HTTP 200, `model == qwen3-4b-awq-embedding` and
+   `len(data[0].embedding) == 2560` (the stable contract, vllm issue #71).
+3. Embeddings direct on the engine :8005 -> same request, to localise the fault
+   (sidecar dead vs engine dead). Does not raise on its own.
+4. STT (whisper-webui) -> `/health` must be 200 AND `/v1/models` must answer any
+   of {200, 401, 403}. Those three statuses prove the FastAPI app is alive and
+   routing; the episode's 502/500 would fail this, and the keyless 401 is
+   precisely "alive and enforcing auth".
+
+DELIBERATE NON-GOAL: no real whisper transcription.
+`whisper-webui` is pinned to GPU 1 (`DeviceIDs: ["1"]`), which belongs to another
+lane. Firing a transcription would load a model on that GPU. The HTTP-level
+check catches the class that actually bit us (502/500) without touching GPU 1.
+An operator who accepts the GPU cost can pass --deep-whisper.
+
+ESCALATION LADDER (least invasive first)
+----------------------------------------
+  attempt 1 fails -> retry after RETRY_DELAY (absorbs a transient / a warm-up)
+  still failing   -> `docker restart` of the implicated container only,
+                     sidecar before engine, then wait for healthy and re-probe
+  still failing   -> loud FAIL line + exit 1 (alert; nothing else is touched)
+
+Safety rails, because an operator window is not an outage:
+  * Engine unreachable AND the Docker Desktop process is not running -> someone
+    stopped it deliberately: SKIP, no action.
+  * Engine unreachable AND Docker Desktop is running -> this is the "bricked
+    Docker" case covered by the user mandate of 2026-10-24: one
+    `docker desktop restart`, loudly logged.
+  * Per-container restart cap (default 2/hour, state file) so a persistent fault
+    cannot turn into a restart storm.
+
+Usage
+-----
+    python embedding_liveness_guard.py              # one pass (cron / Task Scheduler)
+    python embedding_liveness_guard.py --dry-run    # probe + report, never restart
+    python embedding_liveness_guard.py --deep-whisper
+    python embedding_liveness_guard.py --loop 300   # self-paced loop, seconds
+
+Exit codes: 0 = healthy or skipped, 1 = degraded after escalation, 2 = engine down.
+
+Secrets: the key is read from the .env and never printed, logged or echoed.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+DEFAULT_ENV = r"D:\Production\Embeddings\compose\.env"
+DEFAULT_LOG = r"D:\Production\Embeddings\logs\liveness-guard.jsonl"
+DEFAULT_STATE = r"D:\Production\Embeddings\logs\liveness-guard.state.json"
+
+EMB_MODEL = "qwen3-4b-awq-embedding"
+EMB_DIMS = 2560
+SIDECAR_URL = os.environ.get("EMB_GUARD_SIDECAR_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8004/v1/embeddings")
+ENGINE_URL = os.environ.get("EMB_GUARD_ENGINE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8005/v1/embeddings")
+SIDECAR_CONTAINER = "embedding-proxy-logger"
+ENGINE_CONTAINER = "qwen3_4b_awq_embedding_server"
+WHISPER_HEALTH = os.environ.get("EMB_GUARD_WHISPER_HEALTH", "http://127.0.0.1:8190/health")
+WHISPER_MODELS = os.environ.get("EMB_GUARD_WHISPER_MODELS", "http://127.0.0.1:8190/v1/models")
+WHISPER_CONTAINER = "whisper-webui"
+WHISPER_ALIVE = {200, 401, 403}
+
+RETRY_DELAY = 3.0
+HEALTH_TIMEOUT = 90
+RESTART_CAP_PER_HOUR = 2
+BOOT_RAIL = 300  # seconds; a container younger than this is booting, not broken
+
+
+def now():
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
+
+
+def read_key(path):
+    """Read VLLM_API_KEY from the .env. Value is never returned in any log."""
+    try:
+        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
+            for line in fh:
+                s = line.strip()
+                if s.startswith("VLLM_API_KEY") and "=" in s:
+                    return s.split("=", 1)[1].strip().strip('"').strip("'")
+    except OSError:
+        return None
+    return None
+
+
+def http_json(url, body=None, key=None, timeout=30):
+    """Return (status, parsed_json_or_None, error_text_or_None)."""
+    headers = {}
+    data = None
+    if body is not None:
+        data = json.dumps(body).encode()
+        headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
+    if key:
+        headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + key
+    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=headers)
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:
+            raw = resp.read()
+            try:
+                return resp.status, json.loads(raw), None
+            except ValueError:
+                return resp.status, None, "non-JSON body"
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
+        return exc.code, None, "HTTP %s" % exc.code
+    except Exception as exc:  # connection refused, reset, timeout, DNS...
+        return None, None, "%s: %s" % (type(exc).__name__, exc)
+
+
+def probe_embeddings(url, key, tag):
+    """One real POST. Returns a dict; 'ok' is the only thing callers branch on."""
+    nonce = "%s|%s|%d" % (tag, os.getpid(), time.time_ns())
+    status, payload, err = http_json(
+        url, body={"model": EMB_MODEL, "input": "sonde de vivacite %s" % nonce}, key=key
+    )
+    rec = {"check": "embeddings", "path": tag, "status": status, "ok": False}
+    if status != 200:
+        rec["error"] = err or "status %s" % status
+        return rec
+    try:
+        vec = payload["data"][0]["embedding"]
+        model = payload.get("model")
+    except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError):
+        rec["error"] = "malformed response"
+        return rec
+    rec["model"] = model
+    rec["dims"] = len(vec)
+    if model != EMB_MODEL:
+        rec["error"] = "model mismatch"
+    elif len(vec) != EMB_DIMS:
+        rec["error"] = "dims mismatch (contract is %d)" % EMB_DIMS
+    else:
+        rec["ok"] = True
+    return rec
+
+
+def probe_whisper(deep, key=None):
+    status, _, err = http_json(WHISPER_HEALTH, timeout=15)
+    models_status, _, models_err = http_json(WHISPER_MODELS, key=key, timeout=15)
+    rec = {
+        "check": "whisper",
+        "health_status": status,
+        "models_status": models_status,
+        "ok": status == 200 and models_status in WHISPER_ALIVE,
+    }
+    if not rec["ok"]:
+        rec["error"] = "; ".join(x for x in (err, models_err) if x) or "status pair"
+    rec["deep"] = False
+    if deep:
+        # Explicitly opt-in only: loads a model on GPU 1, which is another lane's.
+        rec["deep"] = True
+        rec["deep_note"] = "transcription skipped: no audio fixture configured"
+    return rec
+
+
+def engine_status():
+    try:
+        out = subprocess.run(
+            ["docker", "version", "--format", "{{.Server.Version}}"],
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            timeout=25,
+        )
+        if out.returncode == 0 and out.stdout.strip():
+            return out.stdout.strip(), None
+        return None, (out.stderr or "").strip()[:200] or "rc=%s" % out.returncode
+    except Exception as exc:
+        return None, "%s: %s" % (type(exc).__name__, exc)
+
+
+def docker_desktop_running():
+    try:
+        out = subprocess.run(
+            ["tasklist", "/FI", "IMAGENAME eq Docker Desktop.exe", "/NH"],
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            timeout=25,
+        )
+        return "Docker Desktop.exe" in (out.stdout or "")
+    except Exception:
+        return True  # unknown -> do not claim a deliberate stop
+
+
+def container_state(name):
+    """(status, health). health is 'none' when the container defines no healthcheck
+    (the sidecar has none), which is NOT an error - a bare template on
+    .State.Health.Status makes docker inspect fail and reads as 'absent'."""
+    try:
+        out = subprocess.run(
+            ["docker", "inspect", name, "--format",
+             "{{.State.Status}}|{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}"],
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            timeout=25,
+        )
+        if out.returncode != 0:
+            return None, "absent"
+        parts = out.stdout.strip().split("|")
+        return parts[0], (parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else "none")
+    except Exception as exc:
+        return None, "%s" % type(exc).__name__
+
+
+def age_seconds(name):
+    """Seconds since the container started, or None if it cannot be read."""
+    try:
+        out = subprocess.run(
+            ["docker", "inspect", name, "--format", "{{.State.StartedAt}}"],
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            timeout=25,
+        )
+        if out.returncode != 0:
+            return None
+        raw = out.stdout.strip()
+        # Go emits nanosecond precision; python only parses microseconds.
+        if "." in raw:
+            head, _, tail = raw.partition(".")
+            tz = "Z" if tail.endswith("Z") else ""
+            raw = head + "." + tail.rstrip("Z")[:6] + tz
+        started = datetime.strptime(raw, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+        return (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - started).total_seconds()
+    except Exception:
+        return None
+
+
+def wait_healthy(name, timeout=HEALTH_TIMEOUT):
+    deadline = time.time() + timeout
+    while time.time() < deadline:
+        status, health = container_state(name)
+        if status == "running" and health in ("healthy", "none", ""):
+            return True
+        time.sleep(3)
+    return False
+
+
+class RestartBudget:
+    """Cap restarts per container so a persistent fault cannot become a storm."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path, cap=RESTART_CAP_PER_HOUR):
+        self.path = path
+        self.cap = cap
+        self.data = {}
+        try:
+            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                self.data = json.load(fh)
+        except (OSError, ValueError):
+            self.data = {}
+
+    def allow(self, name):
+        hist = [t for t in self.data.get(name, []) if time.time() - t < 3600]
+        self.data[name] = hist
+        return len(hist) < self.cap
+
+    def record(self, name):
+        self.data.setdefault(name, []).append(time.time())
+
+    def save(self):
+        try:
+            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(self.path), exist_ok=True)
+            with open(self.path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                json.dump(self.data, fh)
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+
+
+def restart_container(name, budget, dry_run):
+    if dry_run:
+        return "would restart %s (dry-run)" % name
+    # Boot rail: same lesson as the vLLM watchdog v5 - a cold boot is not a
+    # fault, and restarting into it turns an operator window into a loop.
+    # Docker Desktop relaunches the stack on daemon start; the embedder needs
+    # ~1-2 min to answer. Never touch a container younger than BOOT_RAIL.
+    age = age_seconds(name)
+    if age is not None and age < BOOT_RAIL:
+        return "SKIP restart of %s: started %ds ago (< %ds boot rail)" % (name, age, BOOT_RAIL)
+    status, _ = container_state(name)
+    if status in ("created", "restarting"):
+        return "SKIP restart of %s: state=%s (boot in progress)" % (name, status)
+    if not budget.allow(name):
+        return "restart cap reached for %s this hour" % name
+    budget.record(name)
+    budget.save()
+    try:
+        out = subprocess.run(
+            ["docker", "restart", name], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180
+        )
+        if out.returncode != 0:
+            return "docker restart %s failed: %s" % (name, (out.stderr or "").strip()[:160])
+    except Exception as exc:
+        return "docker restart %s raised %s" % (name, type(exc).__name__)
+    ok = wait_healthy(name)
+    return "%s restarted (%s)" % (name, "healthy" if ok else "NOT healthy yet")
+
+
+def log_record(path, record):
+    try:
+        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
+        with open(path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            fh.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+
+
+def one_pass(args):
+    key = read_key(args.env)
+    result = {"ts": now(), "actions": [], "checks": [], "verdict": "UNKNOWN"}
+
+    if not key:
+        result["verdict"] = "NO_KEY"
+        result["checks"].append({"check": "config", "ok": False, "error": "VLLM_API_KEY not found in %s" % args.env})
+        return result
+
+    version, engine_err = engine_status()
+    if not version:
+        if not docker_desktop_running():
+            result["verdict"] = "SKIP_ENGINE_STOPPED"
+            result["checks"].append(
+                {"check": "engine", "ok": False, "skipped": True,
+                 "note": "Docker Desktop not running -> deliberate stop, no action"}
+            )
+            return result
+        result["actions"].append("engine mute with Docker Desktop running -> mandate 2026-10-24: docker desktop restart")
+        if not args.dry_run:
+            try:
+                subprocess.run(["docker", "desktop", "restart"], capture_output=True, timeout=300)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                result["actions"].append("docker desktop restart raised %s" % type(exc).__name__)
+            for _ in range(40):
+                time.sleep(5)
+                version, engine_err = engine_status()
+                if version:
+                    break
+        if not version:
+            result["verdict"] = "ENGINE_DOWN"
+            result["checks"].append({"check": "engine", "ok": False, "error": engine_err})
+            return result
+    result["checks"].append({"check": "engine", "ok": True, "version": version})
+    result["engine_version"] = version
+
+    # --- embeddings, fleet path then direct engine -------------------------
+    fleet = probe_embeddings(SIDECAR_URL, key, "sidecar")
+    if not fleet["ok"]:
+        time.sleep(RETRY_DELAY)
+        fleet = probe_embeddings(SIDECAR_URL, key, "sidecar")
+
+    direct = None
+    if not fleet["ok"]:
+        direct = probe_embeddings(ENGINE_URL, key, "engine")
+
+    if not fleet["ok"]:
+        # Localise before acting: never restart the engine for a sidecar fault.
+        if fleet.get("status") in (401, 403):
+            # 2026-10-29 lesson: a fingerprint sent as a bearer renders a
+            # misleading 401. A restart fixes nothing here - alert only.
+            result["actions"].append(
+                "AUTH class (401/403): restart is futile, no action taken - check the key in %s" % args.env
+            )
+        else:
+            if direct is not None and direct["ok"]:
+                targets = [SIDECAR_CONTAINER]          # engine fine -> relay dead
+            else:
+                targets = [SIDECAR_CONTAINER, ENGINE_CONTAINER]
+            for name in targets:
+                result["actions"].append(restart_container(name, args.budget, args.dry_run))
+            if not args.dry_run:
+                time.sleep(5)
+                fleet = probe_embeddings(SIDECAR_URL, key, "sidecar")
+
+    fleet["ok_after_escalation"] = fleet["ok"]
+    result["checks"].append(fleet)
+    if direct is not None:
+        result["checks"].append(direct)
+
+    # --- whisper, HTTP level only (GPU 1 is another lane) ------------------
+    whisper = probe_whisper(args.deep_whisper, key)
+    if not whisper["ok"]:
+        time.sleep(RETRY_DELAY)
+        whisper = probe_whisper(args.deep_whisper, key)
+    if not whisper["ok"]:
+        # Only act if the app answers nothing at all; a 502/500 means the
+        # container needs a restart, a dead port means the same.
+        result["actions"].append(restart_container(WHISPER_CONTAINER, args.budget, args.dry_run))
+        if not args.dry_run:
+            time.sleep(5)
+            whisper = probe_whisper(args.deep_whisper, key)
+    result["checks"].append(whisper)
+
+    failures = [c for c in result["checks"] if c.get("check") in ("embeddings", "whisper") and not c.get("ok")]
+    result["verdict"] = "OK" if not failures else "DEGRADED"
+    result["failures"] = [c.get("check") + ":" + (c.get("error") or "?") for c in failures]
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Liveness guard for the po-2023 embeddings + STT chain")
+    ap.add_argument("--env", default=DEFAULT_ENV, help="path to the embeddings .env")
+    ap.add_argument("--log", default=DEFAULT_LOG, help="JSONL log path")
+    ap.add_argument("--state", default=DEFAULT_STATE, help="restart-budget state file")
+    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="probe and report, never restart")
+    ap.add_argument("--once", action="store_true", help="single pass (the default; accepted so scheduler command lines read explicitly)")
+    ap.add_argument("--deep-whisper", action="store_true", help="reserved: real transcription (loads GPU 1)")
+    ap.add_argument("--loop", type=int, default=0, help="repeat every N seconds (0 = single pass)")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    args.budget = RestartBudget(args.state)
+
+    while True:
+        res = one_pass(args)
+        log_record(args.log, res)
+
+        stamp = res["ts"]
+        if res["verdict"] in ("OK", "SKIP_ENGINE_STOPPED"):
+            print("[%s] LIVENESS %s" % (stamp, res["verdict"]))
+        else:
+            # Greppable, loud, one line - this is what an operator watches for.
+            print("[%s] LIVENESS FAIL %s :: %s" % (stamp, res["verdict"], "; ".join(res.get("failures") or [res["verdict"]])))
+        for c in res["checks"]:
+            if c["check"] == "embeddings":
+                print("  embeddings %-8s status=%s model=%s dims=%s ok=%s %s" % (
+                    c.get("path"), c.get("status"), c.get("model"), c.get("dims"), c.get("ok"), c.get("error", "")))
+            elif c["check"] == "whisper":
+                print("  whisper    health=%s models=%s ok=%s %s" % (
+                    c.get("health_status"), c.get("models_status"), c.get("ok"), c.get("error", "")))
+            else:
+                print("  %-10s ok=%s %s" % (c["check"], c.get("ok"), c.get("error") or c.get("version") or c.get("note") or ""))
+        for a in res["actions"]:
+            print("  ACTION %s" % a)
+
+        if not args.loop:
+            return 0 if res["verdict"] in ("OK", "SKIP_ENGINE_STOPPED") else (2 if res["verdict"] == "ENGINE_DOWN" else 1)
+        time.sleep(args.loop)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+<#
+.SYNOPSIS
+    Wrapper PowerShell du pruneur du tier fs KV (execution dans WSL, ext4 natif).
+
+.DESCRIPTION
+    Le pruneur vit en Python dans WSL : enumerer /home/user/vllm/.kv-tier-fs
+    depuis Windows via \\wsl.localhost (9p) est lent et fragile (voir
+    _iteration_log/v0320_fstier/NOTES.md, piege des chemins). Ce wrapper appelle
+    donc wsl.exe et laisse le script ecrire lui-meme l'etat JSON cote Windows
+    via /mnt/d.
+
+    DRY-RUN PAR DEFAUT. `-Apply` est requis pour supprimer quoi que ce soit.
+    Plafond : min(MaxGiB, tier + libre invité − GuestFloorGiB,
+                  tier + libre guard-mount − ReservePct%).
+    MaxGiB = 250 depuis le 24/10 soir (mandat user « au mieux ») : a 96 GiB le
+    tier ne retenait que 1,6 h de blocs (ecriture ~60 GiB/h, ~25 GiB supprimes
+    toutes les 30 min) ; toute conversation reprise apres plus de 1,6 h de pause
+    repayait 100-200 K tokens de prefill (~95 s de machine figee pour tous).
+    A 250 GiB : ~4 h de retention. La formule comptait aussi l'espace libre
+    seul, sans les octets du tier : corrige le meme jour.
+    MaxGiB = 96 depuis le 24/10 (GO user) : a 48 GiB le pruneur supprimait
+    ~23 GiB toutes les 90 min, en pleine sonde (23:50:02Z : 896 fichiers /
+    22,9 GiB), ce qui detruisait le cache prefixe des conversations longues
+    (57 % des requetes > 100 K tokens) et forcait un re-prefill de 70-140 s
+    par tour. Le garde-fou disque reste actif : min() ci-dessus.
+    Tourne en root WSL (-u root) : les blocs sont ecrits par le conteneur (root)
+    dans des sous-repertoires 755 — l'utilisateur par defaut ne peut pas supprimer
+    (mesure 21/10 : Permission denied sur la sonde de suppression).
+
+.EXAMPLE
+    .\fstier_prune.ps1                 # dry-run, etat ecrit dans logs/fstier_state.json
+    .\fstier_prune.ps1 -Apply          # suppression reelle (fenetre validee uniquement)
+#>
+[CmdletBinding()]
+param(
+    [switch]$Apply,
+    [double]$MaxGiB = 250,
+    [double]$ReservePct = 12,
+    [int]$MinAgeMin = 30,
+    [string]$GuardMounts = '/mnt/c',
+    [string]$Distro = 'Ubuntu'
+)
+
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+$script = '/mnt/d/vllm/myia_vllm/scripts/monitoring/fstier_pruner.py'
+$state  = '/mnt/d/vllm/myia_vllm/logs/fstier_state.json'
+
+if (-not (Test-Path $script)) {
+    # Depuis Windows on ne voit pas /mnt/d ; verifier via le chemin Windows equivalent.
+    if (-not (Test-Path 'd:\vllm\myia_vllm\scripts\monitoring\fstier_pruner.py')) {
+        throw "fstier_pruner.py introuvable (ni /mnt/d ni d:\vllm)"
+    }
+}
+
+$wslArgs = @('-d', $Distro, '-u', 'root', '--exec', 'python3', $script,
+             '--state-file', $state,
+             '--max-gib', "$MaxGiB",
+             '--reserve-pct', "$ReservePct",
+             '--min-age-min', "$MinAgeMin",
+             '--guard-mounts', $GuardMounts)
+if ($Apply) { $wslArgs += '--apply' }
+
+& wsl.exe @wslArgs
+$rc = $LASTEXITCODE
+if ($rc -ne 0) { Write-Warning "fstier_pruner exit=$rc" }
+exit $rc

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""External pruner for the KV offload fs tier (TieringOffloadingSpec).
+
+Why this exists
+---------------
+The fs tier (see `_iteration_log/v0320_fstier/NOTES.md`) has **no eviction and
+no cap in code** (verified in-code 2026-10-20). Left alone it fills the disk:
+24 GB in a 30-minute synthetic window. This script is the mandatory external
+pruner that keeps it bounded.
+
+Layout (content-addressed, one file per KV block):
+    <root>/<model>_<hash>_r<TP rank>/<3 hex>/<block>
+    blocks are 26_247_168 B (~25 MB) on the Swift-1.5 nvfp4 config.
+
+Cap policy (arbitrated with Maintenance 2026-10-20, corrected 2026-10-21,
+2026-10-24):
+    cap = min(MAX_GIB, tier + guest_free - guest_floor,
+              for each guard mount: tier + free - 12% of its total)
+
+The tier's own bytes are part of the room it may occupy: the cap answers "how
+big may the tier be", i.e. how far it may grow before free space reaches the
+reserve. Until 2026-10-24 the formula compared the tier's total with free space
+alone, so the tier could never exceed half of its allowed room (and the bytes it
+already held were counted twice).
+
+The tier physically lives in the Ubuntu WSL ext4.vhdx
+(`C:\\Users\\MYIA\\AppData\\Local\\wsl\\{...}\\ext4.vhdx`, 850 GB, on C:),
+NOT on D: — measured 2026-10-21 via the Lxss registry key. So the volume to
+guard is C: (where the vhdx grows) plus the guest filesystem itself. D: at
+90% is a separate host concern and must not cap this tier.
+
+Safety rules
+------------
+- DRY-RUN by default; `--apply` is required to delete anything.
+- Only files under `<root>/*_r<digits>/*/<file>` are candidates — the root and
+  the model namespace directories are never removed.
+- Files modified less than `--min-age-min` ago are left alone: a fresh block
+  may be mid-promotion (lookup = file existence; a delete between lookup and
+  load is the documented `kv_load_failure_policy='fail'` risk).
+- No symlink following, no deletion outside the resolved root.
+- Errors are collected per file and reported, never fatal for the whole run.
+
+State file (readable from Windows and WSL; gitignored under myia_vllm/logs/):
+    myia_vllm/logs/fstier_state.json
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import sys
+import time
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+GIB = 1024 ** 3
+BLOCK_RE = re.compile(r"_r\d+$")  # namespace dir name suffix: <model>_<hash>_r<rank>
+HEX_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{1,3}$")  # shard dir (first hash hex chars)
+MID_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{1,2}_g\d+$")  # v0.32.0 mid dir: <2hex>_g<generation>
+
+
+def utcnow() -> str:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
+
+
+def compute_cap(root: str, guard_mounts: list[str], max_gib: float,
+                reserve_pct: float, guest_floor_gib: float,
+                tier_bytes: int = 0) -> dict:
+    """cap = min(max_gib, tier + guest_free - guest_floor,
+                 for each mount: tier + free - reserve%)."""
+    checks = {}
+    availables = []
+    # Guest root filesystem: absolute floor (it hosts the HF cache + WSL system,
+    # a percentage of its total would be both huge and meaningless).
+    try:
+        usage = shutil.disk_usage(root)
+        floor = int(guest_floor_gib * GIB)
+        available = max(0, tier_bytes + usage.free - floor)
+        checks["guest_root"] = {
+            "path": root, "total_bytes": usage.total, "free_bytes": usage.free,
+            "floor_bytes": floor, "available_bytes": available,
+        }
+        availables.append(available)
+    except OSError as exc:
+        checks["guest_root"] = {"path": root, "error": str(exc)}
+    # Guard mounts (host volumes backing the vhdx): percentage reserve.
+    for m in guard_mounts:
+        try:
+            usage = shutil.disk_usage(m)
+        except OSError as exc:
+            checks[m] = {"path": m, "error": str(exc)}
+            continue
+        reserve = int(usage.total * reserve_pct / 100.0)
+        # The vhdx never shrinks, so deleting tier files does not give C: its
+        # space back; but the tier reuses the ext4 blocks it frees, so its size
+        # can grow only until C: free reaches the reserve.
+        available = max(0, tier_bytes + usage.free - reserve)
+        checks[m] = {
+            "path": m, "total_bytes": usage.total, "free_bytes": usage.free,
+            "reserve_bytes": reserve, "available_bytes": available,
+        }
+        availables.append(available)
+    cap = min([int(max_gib * GIB)] + availables) if availables else 0
+    return {
+        "cap_bytes": cap,
+        "max_gib": max_gib,
+        "reserve_pct": reserve_pct,
+        "guest_floor_gib": guest_floor_gib,
+        "space_checks": checks,
+    }
+
+
+def collect(root: str, min_age_min: int) -> tuple[list[dict], list[str], int, int]:
+    """Return (candidates sorted oldest-first, errors, files_total, bytes_total)."""
+    now = time.time()
+    min_age_s = min_age_min * 60
+    candidates: list[dict] = []
+    errors: list[str] = []
+    files_total = 0
+    bytes_total = 0
+
+    if not os.path.isdir(root):
+        return [], [f"root not found: {root}"], 0, 0
+
+    for ns in os.scandir(root):
+        if not ns.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False) or not BLOCK_RE.search(ns.name):
+            continue  # namespace must be <model>_<hash>_r<rank>
+        for shard in os.scandir(ns.path):
+            if not shard.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False) or not HEX_RE.match(shard.name):
+                continue
+            for mid in os.scandir(shard.path):
+                # Layouts seen on v0.32.0: <ns>/<3hex>/<2hex>_g<gen>/<hash>.bin
+                # (mid = dir); keep support for a block file directly under
+                # <3hex> in case the mid level disappears on a future release.
+                if mid.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
+                    if not MID_RE.match(mid.name):
+                        continue
+                    entries = os.scandir(mid.path)
+                elif mid.is_file(follow_symlinks=False):
+                    entries = [mid]
+                else:
+                    continue
+                for entry in entries:
+                    try:
+                        if not entry.is_file(follow_symlinks=False):
+                            continue
+                        st = entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False)
+                    except OSError as exc:  # vanished between scandir and stat
+                        errors.append(f"{entry.path}: {exc}")
+                        continue
+                    files_total += 1
+                    bytes_total += st.st_size
+                    if now - st.st_mtime <= min_age_s:
+                        continue  # too fresh: possibly in-flight
+                    candidates.append({"path": entry.path, "size": st.st_size, "mtime": st.st_mtime})
+
+    candidates.sort(key=lambda c: c["mtime"])
+    return candidates, errors, files_total, bytes_total
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Prune the vLLM KV fs offload tier (dry-run by default).")
+    ap.add_argument("--root", default="/home/user/vllm/.kv-tier-fs", help="tier root inside WSL")
+    ap.add_argument("--guard-mounts", default="/mnt/c",
+                    help="comma-separated volumes whose free space must be preserved "
+                         "(default /mnt/c: host of the Ubuntu ext4.vhdx that backs the tier)")
+    ap.add_argument("--max-gib", type=float, default=48.0, help="hard cap regardless of free space")
+    ap.add_argument("--reserve-pct", type=float, default=12.0, help="percent of a guard mount's total kept free")
+    ap.add_argument("--guest-floor-gib", type=float, default=40.0,
+                    help="absolute GB kept free on the guest FS (hosts HF cache + WSL system)")
+    ap.add_argument("--min-age-min", type=int, default=30, help="never delete blocks younger than this")
+    ap.add_argument("--state-file", default="/mnt/d/vllm/myia_vllm/logs/fstier_state.json")
+    ap.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true", help="actually delete (default: dry-run)")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+
+    started = time.time()
+    guard = [m.strip() for m in args.guard_mounts.split(",") if m.strip()]
+    candidates, errors, files_total, bytes_total = collect(args.root, args.min_age_min)
+    cap = compute_cap(args.root, guard, args.max_gib, args.reserve_pct, args.guest_floor_gib,
+                      tier_bytes=bytes_total)
+
+    over = bytes_total - cap["cap_bytes"]
+    deleted_n = 0
+    deleted_bytes = 0
+    freed = 0
+    for c in candidates:
+        if freed >= over:
+            break
+        if args.apply:
+            try:
+                os.remove(c["path"])
+                deleted_n += 1
+                deleted_bytes += c["size"]
+                freed += c["size"]
+            except OSError as exc:
+                errors.append(f"delete {c['path']}: {exc}")
+        else:
+            deleted_n += 1  # would-delete count
+            deleted_bytes += c["size"]
+            freed += c["size"]
+
+    state = {
+        "ts_utc": utcnow(),
+        "root": args.root,
+        "mode": "apply" if args.apply else "dry-run",
+        "min_age_min": args.min_age_min,
+        **cap,
+        "files_total": files_total,
+        "bytes_total": bytes_total,
+        "bytes_over_cap": max(0, over),
+        "candidates": len(candidates),
+        "deleted_files": deleted_n,
+        "deleted_bytes": deleted_bytes,
+        "bytes_after_expected": bytes_total - freed,
+        "errors": errors[:50],
+        "errors_count": len(errors),
+        "elapsed_s": round(time.time() - started, 2),
+    }
+
+    try:
+        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(args.state_file), exist_ok=True)
+        tmp = args.state_file + ".tmp"
+        with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            json.dump(state, fh, indent=2)
+        os.replace(tmp, args.state_file)  # atomic
+    except OSError as exc:
+        state["state_write_error"] = str(exc)
+
+    print(json.dumps(state, indent=2))
+    # Exit 0 even with per-file errors (they are reported); exit 2 only if root missing.
+    return 2 if any(e.startswith("root not found") for e in errors) else 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+# Register the fs-tier pruner scheduled task for the current user (no elevation).
+# Dry-run by default: prints the exact task XML and does nothing; -Apply registers it. -Remove unregisters it.
+#
+# The task runs fstier_prune.ps1 -Apply every 30 min: the pruner itself only deletes
+# blocks OLDER than 30 min and only down to the cap (min(MaxGiB, guest_free-floor,
+# guard-mount free-reserve)) — under the cap it is a no-op that still writes
+# fstier_state.json (the surveillance cycles read it). Owner ai-01:vllm, PR #142.
+param([switch]$Apply, [switch]$Remove, [switch]$Verify, [string]$Name = 'fstier-prune', [string]$Start = '00:20')
+$wrapper = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path) 'fstier_prune.ps1'
+$pwsh = 'C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe'
+$user = [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name
+$begin = (Get-Date).Date.Add([TimeSpan]::Parse($Start)).ToString('s')
+
+# -Verify : preuve que la tache EXECUTE, pas qu'elle est enregistree.
+# 26/10 : la tache se declenchait toutes les 30 min avec LastTaskResult=0 et ne
+# faisait RIEN (le durcissement "fenetre invisible" a remplace l'action par un
+# lanceur VBS ; le chemin de l'executable, non quote, resolvait "C:\Program" ->
+# 0x80070002). LastTaskResult=0 prouve que le LANCEUR a fini, pas le travail.
+# La preuve = l'etat ecrit (fstier_state.json) avance apres un declenchement.
+if ($Verify) {
+    $fails = 0
+    $t = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+    if (-not $t) { "FAIL: tache '$Name' absente"; exit 1 }
+    $act = $t.Actions[0]
+    "ACTION: $($act.Execute) $($act.Arguments)"
+    if ($act.Execute -match 'wscript\.exe') {
+        if ($act.Arguments -notmatch '"([^"]+\.vbs)"') { "FAIL: arguments du lanceur illisibles"; exit 1 }
+        $vbs = $Matches[1]
+        if (-not (Test-Path $vbs)) { "FAIL: lanceur VBS introuvable ($vbs)"; exit 1 }
+        $m = Select-String -Path $vbs -Pattern 'sh\.Run\("(.+)"' | Select-Object -First 1
+        if (-not $m) { "FAIL: ligne sh.Run introuvable dans $vbs"; exit 1 }
+        $cmd = $m.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value.Trim().Replace('""', '"')
+        if ($cmd.StartsWith('"')) { $exe = ($cmd -split '"')[1] } else { $exe = ($cmd -split ' ')[0] }
+        if (-not (Test-Path $exe)) {
+            $exe2 = ((($cmd -split ' ')[0..1]) -join ' ')
+            if (Test-Path $exe2) {
+                "FAIL: chemin d'executable NON QUOTE dans $vbs -> 0x80070002 (tache muette)"; $fails++
+            } else { "FAIL: executable du lanceur introuvable ($exe)"; $fails++ }
+        } else { "OK: chemin d'executable resolvable" }
+    }
+    $state = 'D:\vllm\myia_vllm\logs\fstier_state.json'
+    $before = (Get-Item $state -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).LastWriteTimeUtc
+    Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $Name
+    Start-Sleep -Seconds 30
+    $after = (Get-Item $state -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).LastWriteTimeUtc
+    if ($after -and $before -and $after -gt $before) { "OK: etat ecrit a $after" }
+    else { "FAIL: etat non ecrit apres declenchement (tache muette ?)"; $fails++ }
+    if ($fails) { "VERIFY: $fails ECHEC(S)"; exit 1 }
+    "VERIFY: OK"
+    exit 0
+}
+
+$xml = @"
+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?>
+<Task version="1.4" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/windows/2004/02/mit/task">
+  <RegistrationInfo><Description>KV fs-tier pruner (TieringOffloadingSpec): every 30 min, apply-if-over-cap only, min-age 30 min. The fs tier has NO in-code eviction. Owner ai-01:vllm.</Description></RegistrationInfo>
+  <Triggers>
+    <TimeTrigger>
+      <StartBoundary>$begin</StartBoundary>
+      <Repetition><Interval>PT30M</Interval><StopAtDurationEnd>false</StopAtDurationEnd></Repetition>
+      <Enabled>true</Enabled>
+    </TimeTrigger>
+  </Triggers>
+  <Principals><Principal id="Author"><UserId>$user</UserId><LogonType>InteractiveToken</LogonType><RunLevel>LeastPrivilege</RunLevel></Principal></Principals>
+  <Settings>
+    <MultipleInstancesPolicy>IgnoreNew</MultipleInstancesPolicy>
+    <DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>false</DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>
+    <StartWhenAvailable>false</StartWhenAvailable>
+    <ExecutionTimeLimit>PT10M</ExecutionTimeLimit>
+    <Enabled>true</Enabled>
+  </Settings>
+  <Actions Context="Author">
+    <Exec><Command>$pwsh</Command><Arguments>-NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -File "$wrapper" -Apply</Arguments></Exec>
+  </Actions>
+</Task>
+"@
+if ($Remove) { Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $Name -Confirm:$false; "removed $Name"; return }
+if (-not $Apply) { "DRY-RUN: would register '$Name' for $user with this definition (nothing changed):"; $xml; return }
+Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $Name -Xml $xml | Select-Object TaskName, State

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""
+leaked_key_monitor.py — Monitor usage of the leaked vLLM "medium" API key.
+
+Context (2026-05): a student leaked the medium API key (7711C3D0...). Rotating it
+is impractical (a whole class + many services depend on it), so the decision is
+MONITORING ONLY — no rotation. The error_source_capture ASGI middleware already
+logs every /v1/* request (incl. real client IP via X-Forwarded-For) to
+error_sources.jsonl. This script turns that raw log into an actionable signal:
+which *unknown* public IPs are using the leaked key.
+
+What it does
+------------
+1. Parse error_sources.jsonl, keep only requests authenticated with the leaked key
+   (matched by the key prefix derived from VLLM_API_KEY_MEDIUM in .env — the secret
+   itself is never written into this file).
+2. Resolve the real client IP (left-most X-Forwarded-For hop, else X-Real-IP),
+   stripping ports. Internal traffic (watchdog / localhost, no XFF) is ignored.
+3. Diff each public IP against an allowlist of known-good IPs AND a persisted
+   "already seen / acknowledged" state, so a given IP alerts only ONCE.
+4. Detect anomalies: new unauthorized public IP, volume spike, off-hours activity.
+5. Emit a French markdown summary (dashboard-ready) on stdout, append structured
+   alerts to leaked_key_alerts.jsonl, and update the state file.
+
+Exit codes:  0 = no new alert   2 = new alert(s) raised   1 = error
+(So a scheduled task can branch on the exit code to decide whether to escalate.)
+
+Usage
+-----
+  python leaked_key_monitor.py                 # incremental hourly scan
+  python leaked_key_monitor.py --full          # rescan whole file (ignore high-water)
+  python leaked_key_monitor.py --baseline      # record current IPs as acknowledged, no alert
+  python leaked_key_monitor.py --report        # full-history human report, no state change
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+from collections import defaultdict
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+# --- Paths (resolved relative to this script: myia_vllm/scripts/monitoring/) ---
+HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+MYIA_VLLM = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, "..", ".."))
+LOG_PATH = os.path.join(MYIA_VLLM, "logs", "error_sources.jsonl")
+STATE_PATH = os.path.join(MYIA_VLLM, "logs", "leaked_key_monitor_state.json")
+ALERT_PATH = os.path.join(MYIA_VLLM, "logs", "leaked_key_alerts.jsonl")
+# Dashboard-ready markdown of the LAST alert batch (overwritten each alerting run).
+# The headless-Claude relay reads this file verbatim to post to the dashboards,
+# which keeps the French/accented content out of PowerShell's console encoding.
+LAST_ALERT_PATH = os.path.join(MYIA_VLLM, "logs", "leaked_key_last_alert.md")
+ENV_PATH = os.path.join(MYIA_VLLM, ".env")
+
+# --- Allowlist: known-good public/LAN IPs of legitimate users/services. ---
+# Editable here OR via the state file's "allowlist" array (state takes precedence
+# when present, so you can acknowledge a new legit IP without touching code).
+#
+# Identifications confirmed 2026-05-26 by user:
+#   - 37.187.180.135 = myia-web1 (OVH server, NOT po-2023; po-2023 is local-loop only)
+#   - 92.150.81.115  = jsboige itinerant (Marseille 2026-05, Free.fr); when in Paris
+#                      next week the user is on local loop, so a new Paris IP will be
+#                      him as well — flag but don't panic.
+#   - 212.222.31.210 = EPITA Travel-Planner CP-SAT project (Atos/Bouygues egress)
+#   - 86.246.3.30    = EPITA student from home (IDF, Orange)
+#   - 163.5.3.41     = EPITA school machine (RENATER campus)
+#   - 192.168.0.254  = LAN reverse proxy
+#
+# Authorized non-listed populations: EPITA students (if usage stays reasonable),
+# Jamin and Candy on the Hacienda projects. New IPs from any of these are expected.
+DEFAULT_ALLOWLIST = {
+    "37.187.180.135",   # myia-web1 (OVH)
+    "212.222.31.210",   # EPITA Travel-Planner CP-SAT (Atos/Bouygues egress)
+    "92.150.81.115",    # jsboige Marseille (Free.fr)
+    "86.246.3.30",      # étudiant EPITA depuis chez lui (Orange IDF)
+    "163.5.3.41",       # machine EPITA école (RENATER)
+    "192.168.0.254",    # LAN reverse proxy
+}
+
+# --- Anomaly thresholds ---
+VOLUME_SPIKE_PER_HOUR = 300   # >N reqs/h from a single non-allowlist IP -> spike alert
+OFF_HOURS = range(0, 6)       # local hours considered "off-hours" (00:00-05:59)
+BODY_SAMPLE_CHARS = 220       # head-chars kept per body sample shown in the alert
+BODY_SAMPLES_PER_IP = 3       # max distinct body samples surfaced per new IP
+
+
+def load_medium_key_prefix() -> str | None:
+    """Derive the leaked-key match prefix from .env, without storing the secret here.
+
+    The middleware records auth_prefix as 'Bearer ' + first 17 chars of the token
+    + '...'. We match on 'Bearer ' + key[:17].
+    """
+    key = os.environ.get("VLLM_API_KEY_MEDIUM")
+    if not key and os.path.exists(ENV_PATH):
+        with open(ENV_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            for line in f:
+                line = line.strip()
+                if line.startswith("VLLM_API_KEY_MEDIUM"):
+                    _, _, val = line.partition("=")
+                    key = val.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
+                    break
+    if not key:
+        return None
+    return "Bearer " + key[:17]
+
+
+def real_client_ip(d: dict) -> str | None:
+    """Left-most X-Forwarded-For hop (the original client), else X-Real-IP.
+
+    Returns None for internal traffic (no XFF/XRI = watchdog/localhost).
+    """
+    xff = (d.get("x_forwarded_for") or "").strip()
+    if xff:
+        hop = xff.split(",")[0].strip().strip("[]")
+        # strip ":port" only when it's a single colon (IPv4:port), not IPv6
+        if hop.count(":") == 1:
+            hop = hop.rsplit(":", 1)[0]
+        if hop:
+            return hop
+    xri = (d.get("x_real_ip") or "").strip().strip("[]")
+    if xri:
+        if xri.count(":") == 1:
+            xri = xri.rsplit(":", 1)[0]
+        return xri or None
+    return None
+
+
+def is_public(ip: str) -> bool:
+    return not ip.startswith(("10.", "192.168.", "172.16.", "172.17.", "172.18.",
+                              "172.19.", "172.2", "172.3", "127.", "169.254."))
+
+
+def load_state() -> dict:
+    if os.path.exists(STATE_PATH):
+        try:
+            with open(STATE_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+                return json.load(f)
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+    return {"high_water_ts": 0.0, "seen_ips": {}, "allowlist": []}
+
+
+def save_state(state: dict) -> None:
+    tmp = STATE_PATH + ".tmp"
+    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+        json.dump(state, f, indent=2)
+    os.replace(tmp, STATE_PATH)
+
+
+def scan(key_prefix: str, since_ts: float):
+    """Aggregate leaked-key requests with ts > since_ts, grouped by real public IP.
+
+    Per IP we keep: counts/timestamps/status/off-hours, top user-agents, top hosts,
+    top model names, top paths, and up to BODY_SAMPLES_PER_IP distinct body_head
+    samples (truncated to BODY_SAMPLE_CHARS) so the alert can show *what* the IP
+    is actually doing — not just that it exists.
+    """
+    def _fresh():
+        return {"count": 0, "first": 9e18, "last": 0.0,
+                "status": defaultdict(int), "off_hours": 0,
+                "user_agents": defaultdict(int),
+                "hosts": defaultdict(int),
+                "models": defaultdict(int),
+                "paths": defaultdict(int),
+                "body_samples": [],            # list[str], deduped, max BODY_SAMPLES_PER_IP
+                "_sample_keys": set()}         # in-memory dedup, not serialized
+    agg = defaultdict(_fresh)
+    max_ts = since_ts
+    total = internal = 0
+    with open(LOG_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+        for line in f:
+            try:
+                d = json.loads(line)
+            except Exception:
+                continue
+            if not (d.get("auth_prefix") or "").startswith(key_prefix):
+                continue
+            ts = float(d.get("ts", 0) or 0)
+            if ts <= since_ts:
+                continue
+            max_ts = max(max_ts, ts)
+            ip = real_client_ip(d)
+            if ip is None:
+                internal += 1
+                continue
+            if not is_public(ip):
+                continue  # LAN proxy etc. handled via allowlist if needed
+            total += 1
+            a = agg[ip]
+            a["count"] += 1
+            a["first"] = min(a["first"], ts)
+            a["last"] = max(a["last"], ts)
+            a["status"][int(d.get("status", 0) or 0)] += 1
+            a["user_agents"][(d.get("user_agent") or "?")[:80]] += 1
+            host = (d.get("x_forwarded_host") or d.get("host") or "?").split(",")[0].strip()
+            a["hosts"][host[:60]] += 1
+            a["models"][(d.get("model") or "?")[:40]] += 1
+            a["paths"][(d.get("path") or "?")[:60]] += 1
+            body = (d.get("body_head") or "").strip()
+            if body and len(a["body_samples"]) < BODY_SAMPLES_PER_IP:
+                # dedup on a stable shape (key first ~120 chars compressed)
+                key = " ".join(body.split())[:120]
+                if key and key not in a["_sample_keys"]:
+                    a["_sample_keys"].add(key)
+                    a["body_samples"].append(body[:BODY_SAMPLE_CHARS])
+            if datetime.fromtimestamp(ts).hour in OFF_HOURS:
+                a["off_hours"] += 1
+    return agg, max_ts, total, internal
+
+
+def fmt_ts(t: float) -> str:
+    if not t or t > 9e17:
+        return "?"
+    return datetime.fromtimestamp(t).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Monitor leaked medium API key usage.")
+    ap.add_argument("--full", action="store_true", help="rescan whole file")
+    ap.add_argument("--baseline", action="store_true",
+                    help="record current public IPs as acknowledged, raise no alert")
+    ap.add_argument("--report", action="store_true",
+                    help="full-history human report, no state change")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+
+    if not os.path.exists(LOG_PATH):
+        print(f"ERROR: log not found: {LOG_PATH}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    key_prefix = load_medium_key_prefix()
+    if not key_prefix:
+        print("ERROR: could not derive medium key prefix (set VLLM_API_KEY_MEDIUM "
+              "or check .env)", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    state = load_state()
+    allowlist = set(DEFAULT_ALLOWLIST) | set(state.get("allowlist", []))
+    seen = state.get("seen_ips", {})
+
+    since = 0.0 if (args.full or args.baseline or args.report) else state.get("high_water_ts", 0.0)
+    agg, max_ts, total, internal = scan(key_prefix, since)
+
+    # Classify
+    new_alerts = []
+    for ip, a in sorted(agg.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]["count"]):
+        if ip in allowlist:
+            continue
+        known = ip in seen
+        spike = a["count"] >= VOLUME_SPIKE_PER_HOUR
+        if not known:
+            new_alerts.append(("NEW_IP", ip, a))
+        elif spike:
+            new_alerts.append(("VOLUME_SPIKE", ip, a))
+        # update/record seen state
+        rec = seen.get(ip, {"first": a["first"], "count": 0})
+        rec["last"] = a["last"]
+        rec["count"] = rec.get("count", 0) + a["count"]
+        rec["first"] = min(rec.get("first", a["first"]), a["first"])
+        seen[ip] = rec
+
+    # --- REPORT mode: print everything, change nothing ---
+    if args.report:
+        print(f"# Rapport monitoring clé leakée (full history)\n")
+        print(f"- Log: {LOG_PATH}")
+        print(f"- Requêtes clé leakée (publiques): {total} | interne (watchdog): {internal}")
+        print(f"- IP publiques distinctes: {len(agg)}\n")
+        print("| IP réelle | statut | requêtes | première | dernière | off-h |")
+        print("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
+        for ip, a in sorted(agg.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]["count"]):
+            tag = "✅ allow" if ip in allowlist else "⚠️ INCONNUE"
+            print(f"| `{ip}` | {tag} | {a['count']} | {fmt_ts(a['first'])} | "
+                  f"{fmt_ts(a['last'])} | {a['off_hours']} |")
+        return 0
+
+    # --- BASELINE mode: acknowledge current IPs, no alert ---
+    if args.baseline:
+        state["seen_ips"] = seen
+        state["high_water_ts"] = max_ts
+        if "allowlist" not in state:
+            state["allowlist"] = []
+        save_state(state)
+        print(f"BASELINE recorded: {len(seen)} public IP(s) acknowledged, "
+              f"high_water={fmt_ts(max_ts)}. No alert raised.")
+        return 0
+
+    # --- Normal scan: persist state, emit alerts ---
+    state["seen_ips"] = seen
+    state["high_water_ts"] = max_ts
+    state.setdefault("allowlist", [])
+    save_state(state)
+
+    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+    if not new_alerts:
+        print(f"[{now}] RAS — {total} requête(s) clé leakée depuis {fmt_ts(since)}, "
+              f"aucune nouvelle IP non autorisée.")

+
+    # Build dashboard-ready French markdown + structured alert records.
+    # Tone is intentionally factual (not alarmist): legitimate populations are
+    # documented just below the heading so the reader can attribute fast.
+    n_new_ip = sum(1 for k, _, _ in new_alerts if k == "NEW_IP")
+    n_spike  = sum(1 for k, _, _ in new_alerts if k == "VOLUME_SPIKE")
+    heading_bits = []
+    if n_new_ip: heading_bits.append(f"{n_new_ip} nouvelle(s) IP à identifier")
+    if n_spike:  heading_bits.append(f"{n_spike} pic(s) de volume")
+    heading = " · ".join(heading_bits) or f"{len(new_alerts)} événement(s)"
+
+    lines = [
+        f"🔎 **Monitoring clé medium — {heading}** ({now})",
+        "",
+        "_Décision en vigueur : monitoring seulement, **pas de rotation** "
+        "(toute la classe + la prod en dépendent)._",
+        "",
+        "**Sources légitimes connues** (pas une alerte si l'IP correspond) : "
+        "étudiants EPITA (école RENATER, Atos/Bouygues, Orange IDF), "
+        "projets Hacienda (Jamin, Candy), `myia-web1` OVH, "
+        "jsboige itinérant (Marseille cette semaine, Paris semaine prochaine). "
+        "L'IP locale `192.168.0.254` est le reverse-proxy LAN.",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for kind, ip, a in new_alerts:
+        if kind == "NEW_IP":
+            label = "Nouvelle IP à identifier"
+        else:
+            label = f"Pic de volume (≥ {VOLUME_SPIKE_PER_HOUR} req/h)"
+        sts  = ", ".join(f"{k}:{v}" for k, v in sorted(a["status"].items())) or "?"
+        # top-N helpers
+        def _top(d, n):
+            return sorted(d.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:n]
+        top_ua    = _top(a["user_agents"], 2)
+        top_host  = _top(a["hosts"], 2)
+        top_model = _top(a["models"], 3)
+        top_path  = _top(a["paths"], 3)
+        ua_top = top_ua[0][0] if top_ua else "?"
+
+        lines.append(f"### {label} — `{ip}`")
+        lines.append(
+            f"- **{a['count']} req** ({fmt_ts(a['first'])} → {fmt_ts(a['last'])}) "
+            f"· statuts [{sts}] · off-hours: {a['off_hours']}"
+        )
+        if top_ua:
+            ua_str = ", ".join(f"`{u}` ×{c}" for u, c in top_ua)
+            lines.append(f"- **UA** : {ua_str}")
+        if top_host:
+            lines.append(f"- **Host** : "
+                         + ", ".join(f"`{h}` ×{c}" for h, c in top_host))
+        if top_model:
+            lines.append(f"- **Modèle(s)** : "
+                         + ", ".join(f"`{m}` ×{c}" for m, c in top_model))
+        if top_path:
+            lines.append(f"- **Endpoint(s)** : "
+                         + ", ".join(f"`{p}` ×{c}" for p, c in top_path))
+        if a["body_samples"]:
+            lines.append(f"- **Extraits de prompt** (max {BODY_SAMPLES_PER_IP}, "
+                         f"~{BODY_SAMPLE_CHARS} car. chacun) :")
+            for s in a["body_samples"]:
+                # one-line code block, collapse whitespace for readability
+                compact = " ".join(s.split())
+                lines.append(f"  - `{compact}`")
+        lines.append("")
+
+        with open(ALERT_PATH, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            f.write(json.dumps({
+                "ts": time.time(), "iso": now, "kind": kind, "ip": ip,
+                "count": a["count"], "first": a["first"], "last": a["last"],
+                "status": dict(a["status"]), "off_hours": a["off_hours"],
+                "top_user_agent": ua_top,
+                "top_hosts": dict(top_host),
+                "top_models": dict(top_model),
+                "top_paths": dict(top_path),
+                "body_samples": a["body_samples"],
+            }) + "\n")
+    lines.append(
+        "_Si l'IP est légitime (étudiant, Hacienda, infra MYIA), l'ajouter à "
+        "`leaked_key_monitor_state.json` → `allowlist[]` pour ne plus être alerté._"
+    )
+    alert_md = "\n".join(lines)
+    # Persist the dashboard-ready markdown so the relay can post it verbatim.
+    with open(LAST_ALERT_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+        f.write(alert_md + "\n")
+    print(alert_md)
+    return 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Quick load summary from /logs/error_sources.jsonl — last 24h histogram + UA breakdown."""
+import json, time, collections, datetime, sys
+
+PATH = "/logs/error_sources.jsonl"
+buckets = collections.Counter()
+ua = collections.Counter()
+status_c = collections.Counter()
+model_c = collections.Counter()
+total = 0
+now = time.time()
+since = now - 86400
+total_bytes = 0
+
+with open(PATH) as f:
+    for l in f:
+        try:
+            d = json.loads(l)
+        except Exception:
+            continue
+        if d.get("ts", 0) < since:
+            continue
+        total += 1
+        h = datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(d["ts"]).strftime("%m-%d %H")
+        buckets[h] += 1
+        ua[(d.get("user_agent") or "?")[:30]] += 1
+        status_c[d.get("status")] += 1
+        model_c[d.get("model") or "?"] += 1
+        total_bytes += int(d.get("body_bytes") or 0)
+
+print(f"Last 24h: {total} requests, {total_bytes/1024/1024:.1f} MB body total")
+print("Per hour (UTC):")
+for h, c in sorted(buckets.items())[-24:]:
+    bar = "#" * min(c // 5, 60)
+    print(f"  {h}h  {c:5d}  {bar}")
+print("Status:", dict(status_c))
+print("Models:", dict(model_c))
+print("Top UA:")
+for u, c in ua.most_common(8):
+    print(f"  {c:5d}  {u}")

+<#
+.SYNOPSIS
+    Register the po-2023 embeddings/STT liveness guard as a scheduled task.
+
+.DESCRIPTION
+    Runs myia_vllm/scripts/monitoring/embedding_liveness_guard.py every N minutes
+    and lets the guard restart only the container it implicates when the chain is
+    down (see the script's docstring for the escalation ladder and its rails).
+
+    WHY USER-LEVEL AND NOT SYSTEM:
+    the guard's only useful action is restarting containers, and Docker Desktop on
+    this host runs inside the interactive session. A SYSTEM task would fire while
+    Docker is not running and could only ever report red. So this task is created
+    with /IT (run only when the user is logged on) and needs NO elevation.
+
+    UAC / dry-run discipline (rule of 2026-08-27): registering a scheduled task is
+    a task-scheduler gesture, so a dry-run is mandatory and its output is posted
+    on the dashboard BEFORE the gesture. Use -WhatIf to print the exact command.
+
+.PARAMETER WhatIf
+    Print the command and the pre-checks, change nothing.
+
+.PARAMETER IntervalMinutes
+    Repetition interval. Default 5.
+
+.PARAMETER TaskName
+    Task name. Default 'Embeddings Liveness Guard'.
+
+.PARAMETER Force
+    Recreate the task if it already exists (default: report and exit).
+
+.EXAMPLE
+    .\register_liveness_guard.ps1 -WhatIf
+    .\register_liveness_guard.ps1
+#>
+[CmdletBinding()]
+param(
+    [switch]$WhatIf,
+    [int]$IntervalMinutes = 5,
+    [string]$TaskName = 'Embeddings Liveness Guard',
+    [switch]$Force
+)
+
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+
+$source = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'embedding_liveness_guard.py'
+$runtime = 'D:\Production\Embeddings\bin\embedding_liveness_guard.py'
+$envf   = 'D:\Production\Embeddings\compose\.env'
+
+# The task MUST NOT run the script out of the git worktree. It did, and a plain
+# `git checkout main` deleted the file from disk at 2026-10-29 19:38Z - the task
+# then failed every 5 minutes with LastTaskResult=2 while Get-ScheduledTask still
+# said Ready, for about four hours, silently. A repository is a source, not a
+# runtime location: install a copy outside it and point the task there.
+
+Write-Output "=== Pre-checks ==="
+$ok = $true
+
+if (Test-Path $source) {
+    Write-Output "  source           : OK  $source"
+} else {
+    Write-Output "  source           : MISSING  $source"; $ok = $false
+}
+
+if (Test-Path $envf) {
+    Write-Output "  env file         : OK  $envf"
+} else {
+    Write-Output "  env file         : MISSING  $envf"; $ok = $false
+}
+
+$python = (Get-Command python.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source
+if ($python) {
+    Write-Output "  python           : OK  $python"
+} else {
+    Write-Output "  python           : MISSING from PATH"; $ok = $false
+}
+
+$existing = $null
+try { $existing = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $existing = $null }
+if ($existing) {
+    Write-Output "  existing task    : PRESENT (State=$($existing.State))"
+} else {
+    Write-Output "  existing task    : absent"
+}
+
+if (-not $ok) {
+    Write-Output ""
+    Write-Output "ABORT: pre-checks failed, nothing registered."
+    exit 2
+}
+
+Write-Output "  runtime target   : $runtime"
+
+$cmd = 'schtasks /create /tn "{0}" /tr "\"{1}\" \"{2}\" --once" /sc minute /mo {3} /it /f' -f $TaskName, $python, $runtime, $IntervalMinutes
+
+Write-Output ""
+Write-Output "=== Command ==="
+Write-Output "  $cmd"
+Write-Output ""
+
+if ($existing -and -not $Force) {
+    Write-Output "Task already exists - re-run with -Force to recreate. Nothing changed."
+    exit 0
+}
+
+if ($WhatIf) {
+    Write-Output "DRY-RUN (-WhatIf): nothing executed - no copy installed, no task created or modified."
+    Write-Output ""
+    Write-Output "Would first install: $source"
+    Write-Output "               ->     $runtime"
+    Write-Output "What the task would do every $IntervalMinutes min:"
+    Write-Output "  - POST /v1/embeddings on :8004 (fleet path) with the key, require dims 2560"
+    Write-Output "  - POST /v1/embeddings on :8005 (engine) only to localise a fault"
+    Write-Output "  - HTTP-level check of whisper-webui (:8190), no transcription (GPU 1 is another lane)"
+    Write-Output "  - on failure, restart only the implicated container (cap 2/h), then alert"
+    exit 0
+}
+
+Write-Output ""
+Write-Output "=== Install ==="
+$binDir = Split-Path -Parent $runtime
+if (-not (Test-Path $binDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $binDir -Force | Out-Null }
+Copy-Item -Path $source -Destination $runtime -Force
+if (-not (Test-Path $runtime)) {
+    Write-Output "  copy                 : FAILED - nothing registered"
+    exit 1
+}
+$srcHash = (Get-FileHash $source -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
+$runHash = (Get-FileHash $runtime -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
+if ($srcHash -ne $runHash) {
+    Write-Output "  copy                 : HASH MISMATCH - nothing registered"
+    exit 1
+}
+Write-Output "  copy                 : OK  sha256=$($srcHash.Substring(0,12))"
+
+& schtasks /create /tn "$TaskName" /tr "`"$python`" `"$runtime`" --once" /sc minute /mo $IntervalMinutes /it /f
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
+    Write-Output "schtasks failed with exit $LASTEXITCODE"
+    exit 1
+}
+
+# `schtasks /create` leaves WINDOWS' LAPTOP DEFAULTS in place, and on this host they
+# disarmed the guard twice over in a single night (measured 2026-10-30):
+#
+#   - DisallowStartIfOnBatteries / StopIfGoingOnBatteries default to True. The machine
+#     went on battery at ~04:37Z and every 5-minute tick was silently REFUSED
+#     (LastTaskResult=0x800710E0, "the operator or administrator refused the request")
+#     while Get-ScheduledTask kept reporting Ready.
+#   - ExecutionTimeLimit defaults to PT72H. When the host fell into swap famine (0.4 GB
+#     free), one pass hung on a subprocess and held the task in State=Running; with
+#     MultipleInstances=IgnoreNew every later tick was then refused too. Nothing kills
+#     a 72 h limit, so the guard stayed dead for as long as the pass hung.
+#
+# Both are silent: the task says Ready either way. Bound them explicitly.
+$task = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+if ($task) {
+    $task.Settings.DisallowStartIfOnBatteries = $false
+    $task.Settings.StopIfGoingOnBatteries     = $false
+    $task.Settings.ExecutionTimeLimit         = 'PT10M'
+    Set-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Settings $task.Settings | Out-Null
+    Write-Output "  settings             : batteries allowed, ExecutionTimeLimit=PT10M"
+} else {
+    Write-Output "  settings             : TASK NOT FOUND - cannot apply settings"
+    exit 1
+}
+
+Write-Output ""
+Write-Output "=== Verification ==="
+# Get-ScheduledTask rather than parsing 'schtasks /query /fo LIST': that output is
+# localised ('Nom de la tache', 'Statut'...) and Select-String on English labels
+# silently matches nothing on a French host - a verification that sees nothing.
+$t = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+if (-not $t) {
+    Write-Output "  task                 : NOT FOUND after create - investigate"
+    exit 1
+}
+$info = Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $TaskName
+Write-Output "  task                 : $($t.TaskName)"
+Write-Output "  state                : $($t.State)"
+Write-Output "  action               : $($t.Actions[0].Execute) $($t.Actions[0].Arguments)"
+Write-Output "  principal            : $($t.Principal.UserId) | LogonType=$($t.Principal.LogonType) | RunLevel=$($t.Principal.RunLevel)"
+Write-Output "  next run             : $($info.NextRunTime)"
+$st = (Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName).Settings
+Write-Output "  batteries            : DisallowStart=$($st.DisallowStartIfOnBatteries) StopOnBatteries=$($st.StopIfGoingOnBatteries) (both must be False)"
+Write-Output "  exec time limit      : $($st.ExecutionTimeLimit) (must be bounded, never PT72H)"
+
+Write-Output ""
+Write-Output "DONE - task '$TaskName' registered (user-level, /IT, no elevation)."
+Write-Output "Run it once by hand to prove it end-to-end:"
+Write-Output "  Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName '$TaskName'"
+Write-Output "  Get-Content 'D:\Production\Embeddings\logs\liveness-guard.jsonl' -Tail 1"

+# register_traffic_census.ps1 -- register the user-level hourly traffic-census task
+# =====================================================================================
+# Same proven pattern as nb_audit/register_hourly.ps1 (raw task XML +
+# Register-ScheduledTask -Xml; the New-ScheduledTaskAction object loses its
+# Argument property on this PS5.1 host -- measured 10/10). User-level,
+# LeastPrivilege -> NO UAC prompt.
+#
+# Dry-run by default: prints the exact task XML and does nothing. -Apply
+# registers it. -Remove unregisters it.
+#
+# Cadence: hourly at minute 25 -- clear of the nbaudit runner at :05. The
+# worker's checkpoint makes a late/missed pass safe (it just aggregates more).
+# State trace: %LOCALAPPDATA%\traffic-census\last-result.json (the scheduled-
+# task LastTaskResult is NOT a health signal -- nbaudit 37h-outage lesson).
+# =====================================================================================
+param([switch]$Apply, [switch]$Remove, [string]$Name = 'traffic-census-hourly', [string]$Start = '00:25')
+$worker = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path) 'traffic_census_hourly.ps1'
+$pwsh = 'C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe'
+$user = [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name
+$begin = (Get-Date).Date.Add([TimeSpan]::Parse($Start)).ToString('s')
+$xml = @"
+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?>
+<Task version="1.4" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/windows/2004/02/mit/task">
+  <RegistrationInfo><Description>Persistent hourly aggregation of the :5002 traffic census (po-2025 request, log rotates ~1.2h). Owner ai-01:vllm. State: %LOCALAPPDATA%\traffic-census\last-result.json.</Description></RegistrationInfo>
+  <Triggers>
+    <TimeTrigger>
+      <StartBoundary>$begin</StartBoundary>
+      <Repetition><Interval>PT1H</Interval><StopAtDurationEnd>false</StopAtDurationEnd></Repetition>
+      <Enabled>true</Enabled>
+    </TimeTrigger>
+  </Triggers>
+  <Principals><Principal id="Author"><UserId>$user</UserId><LogonType>InteractiveToken</LogonType><RunLevel>LeastPrivilege</RunLevel></Principal></Principals>
+  <Settings>
+    <MultipleInstancesPolicy>IgnoreNew</MultipleInstancesPolicy>
+    <DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>false</DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>
+    <StartWhenAvailable>true</StartWhenAvailable>
+    <ExecutionTimeLimit>PT10M</ExecutionTimeLimit>
+    <Enabled>true</Enabled>
+  </Settings>
+  <Actions Context="Author">
+    <Exec><Command>$pwsh</Command><Arguments>-NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -File "$worker"</Arguments></Exec>
+  </Actions>
+</Task>
+"@
+if ($Remove) { Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $Name -Confirm:$false; "removed $Name"; return }
+if (-not $Apply) { "DRY-RUN: would register '$Name' for $user with this definition (nothing changed):"; $xml; return }
+Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $Name -Xml $xml | Select-Object TaskName, State

+<#
+.SYNOPSIS
+    Hourly wrapper for the leaked medium API key monitor (scheduled-task entry point).
+
+.DESCRIPTION
+    1. Rotates logs/error_sources.jsonl when it grows past a size cap (the capture
+       middleware opens the file per-write in append mode, so a host-side rename is
+       safe: the next request recreates a fresh error_sources.jsonl). Old archives
+       are gzip'd and pruned after a retention window.
+    2. Runs leaked_key_monitor.py (incremental scan; persists high-water + seen IPs).
+    3. On exit code 2 (a genuinely NEW unauthorized public IP, or a volume spike),
+       launches a headless `claude -p` session that posts the dashboard-ready alert
+       (written by the monitor to logs/leaked_key_last_alert.md, UTF-8) VERBATIM to
+       the two roosync dashboards, SEQUENTIALLY:
+         1) workspace-roo-extensions   2) workspace-cluster-coordination
+       Sequential is mandatory: both live on the same shared GDrive folder and
+       concurrent .tmp->.md renames collide (ENOENT).
+    4. Appends an audit line to logs/leaked_key_monitor_runs.log every run.
+
+    Standing decision: MONITORING ONLY. Never rotate the leaked API key.
+
+.NOTES
+    All string literals here are ASCII so the file is safe to read under both
+    Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7 with no BOM. Any French/accented text
+    is confined to leaked_key_last_alert.md, which Claude reads directly as UTF-8.
+#>
+param(
+    [int]$RotateSizeMB = 100,    # rotate error_sources.jsonl above this size
+    [int]$ArchiveRetentionDays = 90,
+    [switch]$NoEscalate,         # run the monitor + rotation but never call claude
+    [string]$TestWorkspace,      # validation: post only to this one workspace (not prod)
+    [switch]$ForceEscalate       # validation: run the relay even when exit code != 2
+)
+
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+
+# --- Paths (resolved relative to this script: myia_vllm/scripts/monitoring/) ---
+$Here     = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
+$MyiaVllm = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $Here '..\..')).Path
+$LogDir   = Join-Path $MyiaVllm 'logs'
+$Monitor  = Join-Path $Here 'leaked_key_monitor.py'
+$ErrLog   = Join-Path $LogDir 'error_sources.jsonl'
+$ArchDir  = Join-Path $LogDir 'archive'
+$LastAlert= Join-Path $LogDir 'leaked_key_last_alert.md'
+$RunsLog  = Join-Path $LogDir 'leaked_key_monitor_runs.log'
+
+function Write-RunLog([string]$msg) {
+    $stamp = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
+    $line  = "[$stamp] $msg"
+    [System.IO.File]::AppendAllText($RunsLog, $line + "`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+    Write-Host $line
+}
+
+function Resolve-Exe([string[]]$candidates) {
+    foreach ($c in $candidates) {
+        $cmd = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+        if ($cmd) { return $cmd.Source }
+    }
+    return $null
+}
+
+# --- 1. Rotate error_sources.jsonl if oversized -------------------------------
+try {

+        if ($sizeMB -ge $RotateSizeMB) {
+            if (-not (Test-Path $ArchDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ArchDir | Out-Null }

+            Move-Item -LiteralPath $ErrLog -Destination $dest    # next request recreates ErrLog

+                $in.CopyTo($gzs); $gzs.Dispose(); $out.Dispose(); $in.Dispose()
+                Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dest -Force
+                Write-RunLog "ROTATE error_sources.jsonl ($sizeMB MB) -> $([System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($gz))"

+        $rc = $LASTEXITCODE
+        $tail = ($relayOut | Select-Object -Last 4) -join ' | '
+        Write-RunLog "RELAY rc=$rc $tail"
+    } catch {
+        Write-RunLog "RELAY-ERROR $($_.Exception.Message)"
+    }
+}
+

+# traffic_census_hourly.ps1 -- persistent hourly aggregation of :5002 traffic census
+# =============================================================================
+# WHY (09-10/10 2026, po-2025:vllm request): /logs/error_sources.jsonl rotates in
+# ~1.2h (~60-75 req/min). Any question about a past window dies at rotation. This
+# worker aggregates EVERY HOUR into a persistent JSONL that survives rotations.
+#
+# Design (agreed with po-2025:vllm):
+#   - CHECKPOINT (host file) = last ts processed -> each log line is counted
+#     exactly ONCE even though it stays in the file until rotation.
+#   - SIZE CLASSES separate the long-context cohort from the p50:
+#     <1K, 1-10K, 10-50K, 50-100K, 100-800K, >800K  (>800K = Haiku-profile body).
+#   - MODEL counts (11/10): the engine log rotates (~1.2h at 60 req/min) and model
+#     was unrecoverable past rotation -- the 10/10 23:17Z->04:49Z night (crash +
+#     missed cycle) could not answer "did the claudish sub-agent test ever run?".
+#     Model alone does not attribute (Jamin also calls swift-1.5-27b); cross with
+#     ua_top + IP deltas at analysis time.
+#   - KEY DISCRIMINATOR: fingerprints only (sha256[:12] of the 16-char prefix),
+#     NEVER key material. The key is a security threshold, not an identity
+#     (hub calls under MEDIUM for all its clients -- body size is the identity).
+#   - MERGE = SUM into existing hour buckets (checkpoint makes it additive).
+#
+# Result file (%LOCALAPPDATA%\traffic-census\last-result.json) carries the exit
+# state: the scheduled task goes through wscript (hidden window) which swallows
+# exit codes -- the written trace is the only reliable signal (nbaudit lesson,
+# 08/10: 37h of silent outage hid behind LastTaskResult=0).
+#
+# Dry-run: -WhatIf switch assembles everything and prints the plan without
+# touching checkpoint/output files.
+# =============================================================================
+
+param([switch]$WhatIf)
+
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+$Container = 'myia_vllm-medium-swift15-27b'
+$Dir        = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'traffic-census'
+$OutFile    = Join-Path $Dir 'hourly.jsonl'
+$Checkpoint = Join-Path $Dir 'checkpoint.txt'
+$ResultFile = Join-Path $Dir 'last-result.json'
+$Failures   = Join-Path $Dir 'consecutive-failures.txt'
+
+$ts = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')   # NEVER local-as-Z (08/10 lesson)
+$utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)               # PS5.1: -Encoding utf8NoBOM does not exist
+$rc = 0
+try {
+    if (-not (Test-Path $Dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Dir | Out-Null }
+    $ckpt = 0.0
+    if (Test-Path $Checkpoint) { $ckpt = [double](Get-Content $Checkpoint -Raw).Trim() }
+    $bootstrapping = ($ckpt -eq 0.0)
+
+    # --- aggregate INSIDE the container (fingerprints never leave as raw values) ---
+    $py = @'
+import json, time, collections, hashlib
+ckpt = float(CKPT_PLACEHOLDER)
+now = time.time()
+buckets = {}
+for line in open('/logs/error_sources.jsonl', errors='ignore'):
+    try: r = json.loads(line)
+    except: continue
+    t = r.get('ts') or 0
+    if t <= ckpt or t > now: continue
+    h = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H', time.gmtime(t)) + ':00:00Z'
+    b = buckets.setdefault(h, {'n':0,'sizes':collections.Counter(),'status':collections.Counter(),'ua':collections.Counter(),'keys':collections.Counter(),'models':collections.Counter()})
+    n = r.get('body_bytes') or 0
+    cls = '<1K' if n<1000 else '1-10K' if n<10000 else '10-50K' if n<50000 else '50-100K' if n<100000 else '100-800K' if n<800000 else '>800K'
+    ua = (r.get('user_agent') or '?').split('/')[0][:20]
+    key = r.get('auth_prefix') or 'NONE'
+    fp = 'NONE' if key=='NONE' else hashlib.sha256(key.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
+    b['n'] += 1; b['sizes'][cls] += 1; b['status'][str(r.get('status'))] += 1; b['ua'][ua] += 1; b['keys'][fp] += 1; b['models'][(r.get('model') or '?')[:24]] += 1
+out = {'max_ts': ckpt, 'hours': []}
+for h in sorted(buckets):
+    b = buckets[h]
+    out['hours'].append({'hour': h, 'n': b['n'],
+        'sizes': dict(b['sizes']), 'status': dict(b['status']),
+        'ua_top': b['ua'].most_common(3), 'keys': dict(b['keys']),
+        'models': dict(b['models'])})
+# true max ts: recompute cheaply
+mx = ckpt
+for line in open('/logs/error_sources.jsonl', errors='ignore'):
+    try: r = json.loads(line)
+    except: continue
+    t = r.get('ts') or 0
+    if t > ckpt and t <= now: mx = max(mx, t)
+out['max_ts'] = mx
+print(json.dumps(out))
+'@
+    $py = $py.Replace('CKPT_PLACEHOLDER', ([string]$ckpt))
+    if ($WhatIf) {
+        Write-Output "[WHATIF] container=$Container checkpoint=$ckpt out=$OutFile"
+        Write-Output "[WHATIF] would docker exec + aggregate rows ts>$ckpt, merge into $OutFile, advance checkpoint"
+        return
+    }
+    $raw = docker exec $Container python3 -c $py 2>&1
+    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $raw) { throw "docker exec failed (rc=$LASTEXITCODE): $($raw | Select-Object -First 2)" }
+    $agg = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+
+    # --- merge (SUM) into existing persistent buckets ---
+    # A deserialized hour record may LACK a size/status/key class (sparse hour ->
+    # 0 requests in that class -> key never written). Direct property assignment
+    # on a PSCustomObject THROWS on a missing name ("propriété introuvable",
+    # lived 10/10: 3 consecutive task failures once traffic dropped to ~60 req/h),
+    # so every merge goes through read-or-zero + Add-Member (10/10 fix).
+    function Add-ToObj($obj, [string]$name, [long]$delta) {
+        $p = $obj.PSObject.Properties[$name]
+        if ($p) { $p.Value = [long]$p.Value + $delta }
+        else { $obj | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $name -NotePropertyValue $delta | Out-Null }
+    }
+    $store = @{}
+    if (Test-Path $OutFile) {
+        foreach ($l in Get-Content $OutFile) {
+            if (-not $l.Trim()) { continue }
+            $o = $l | ConvertFrom-Json
+            $store[$o.hour] = $o
+        }
+    }
+    foreach ($h in $agg.hours) {
+        if ($store.ContainsKey($h.hour)) {
+            $o = $store[$h.hour]
+            $o.n = [long]$o.n + [long]$h.n
+            foreach ($p in $h.sizes.PSObject.Properties) { Add-ToObj $o.sizes $p.Name ([long]$p.Value) }
+            foreach ($p in $h.status.PSObject.Properties) { Add-ToObj $o.status $p.Name ([long]$p.Value) }
+            # ua_top / keys: re-merge approximately by addition on same keys
+            foreach ($p in $h.keys.PSObject.Properties) { Add-ToObj $o.keys $p.Name ([long]$p.Value) }
+            # models: added 11/10 -- buckets persisted before the field lack it entirely
+            if (-not $o.PSObject.Properties['models']) {
+                $o | Add-Member -NotePropertyName models -NotePropertyValue ([PSCustomObject]@{}) | Out-Null
+            }
+            foreach ($p in $h.models.PSObject.Properties) { Add-ToObj $o.models $p.Name ([long]$p.Value) }
+        } else {
+            $store[$h.hour] = $h
+        }
+    }
+    $lines = foreach ($k in ($store.Keys | Sort-Object)) { $store[$k] | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 6 }
+    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($OutFile, (($lines -join "`n") + "`n"), $utf8NoBom)
+
+    # --- advance checkpoint ONLY after a successful write ---
+    if ($agg.max_ts -gt $ckpt) { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Checkpoint, [string]$agg.max_ts, $utf8NoBom) }
+    $nHours = @($agg.hours).Count; $nRows = ($agg.hours | Measure-Object -Property n -Sum).Sum
+    if (-not $nRows) { $nRows = 0 }
+    Write-Output "ok: +$nRows rows into $nHours hour-bucket(s), checkpoint -> $([math]::Round($agg.max_ts,0))"
+    if (Test-Path $Failures) { Remove-Item $Failures -Force }
+} catch {
+    $rc = 1
+    Write-Output "FAIL: $($_.Exception.Message)"
+    $f = 0; if (Test-Path $Failures) { $f = [int](Get-Content $Failures -Raw).Trim() }
+    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Failures, [string]($f + 1), $utf8NoBom)
+}
+$nFail = 0
+if (Test-Path $Failures) { $nFail = [int]([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Failures)).Trim() }
+$resultJson = @{ ts = $ts; rc = $rc; ok = ($rc -eq 0); consecutive_failures = $nFail } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
+[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($ResultFile, $resultJson, $utf8NoBom)
+exit $rc
